claims: The Artemis II mission uses the Space Launch System (SLS) rocket.
The SLS rocket is built by multiple major aerospace companies contracted by NASA.
Boeing builds the core stage of the SLS rocket.
Northrop Grumman produces the solid rocket boosters of the SLS rocket.
Aerojet Rocketdyne makes the engines of the SLS rocket.
Lockheed Martin built the Orion crew spacecraft for the Artemis II mission.
The Orion spacecraft will carry the crew for the Artemis II mission.
Boeing manufactures the SLS Core Stage and Upper Stage for Artemis II.
Northrop Grumman manufactures the Solid Rocket Boosters for Artemis II.
Aerojet Rocketdyne manufactures the RS-25 Engines for Artemis II.
Lockheed Martin manufactures the Orion Spacecraft for Artemis II.
Airbus manufactures the European Service Module (ESM) for Orion.
The Artemis II mission is scheduled to launch four astronauts around the Moon in 2026.
The Artemis II mission marks the first crewed flight of the SLS and Orion.
